knowledge_graph.title: Legacy High School
knowledge_graph.description: Legacy High School is a high school located in Broomfield, Colorado that opened in 2000. It is within the Adams 12 Five Star Schools District. As of the 2025–2026 school year, the school had an enrollment of 2,048 students.
